invariants.rationale: The method dereferences writeClient and makes two calls on it, so it must be non-null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed to a method and must be non-null to avoid NPE.
instantTime is used by value in two method calls and must be non-null to avoid NPE.
After calling writeClient.commit, the commit should be registered for instantTime.
List size is always non-negative in Java.
